title: Synergy or Interference: The Effect of Product Placement on Commercial Break Audience Decline
authors: David A. Schweidel; Natasha Zhang Foutz; Robin J. Tanner
main_or_robustness: main (hierarchical Bayesian model of second-by-second audience decline during commercials as a function of preceding product placements)

ineligible_specs.exclusion_reason: ad-level linear model with program, category and brand-within-category random effects, network/month/half-hour/genre dummies and placement-match indicators (WinBUGS); no unit FE with staggered binary adoption; not a DiD

eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Ad-level hierarchical Bayesian regression of audience decline on placements.
design_notes: MKSC code.txt (WinBUGS) on 74,224 advertisements; treatment indicators IncImmed/IncPrior vary across ads within breaks, no adoption timing.
data_files_note: Calibration (estimation) sample with network, genre, program, category, brand, month and half-hour identifiers anonymized.
data_provenance_note: Estimation sample with anonymized identifiers; values not reported as altered.
screener_notes: No article text or published PDF available (data/text and papers/ checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read where available; package_mismatch checked against title, authors and README. Regression inventory empty (0 lines); code read directly.
